methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); electric utility signals on FPL Group's own lines

pit_profile.why: NextEra Energy, Inc.: 'FPL is a rate-regulated utility engaged primarily in the generation, transmission, distribution and sale of electric energy in Florida.' and 'NextEra Energy Resources is NextEra Energy's competitive energy subsidiary which produces the majority of its electricity from clean and renewable fuels.'; among its risk factors, 'NextEra Energy’s and FPL’s financial results may be adversely affected by the extensive regulation of their businesses.', 'NextEra Energy’s and FPL’s financial results are subject to risks associated with weather conditions, such as the impact of severe weather.' and 'NextEra Energy’s and FPL’s businesses could be negatively affected by federal or state laws or regulations mandating new or additional limits on the production of GHG emissions.' (its own FY2010 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an electric utility on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on climate change stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

(its own FY2010 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an electric utility on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on climate change stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.42x; +5% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.34; conservative 2yr +35%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -12.6%/yr (worst year FY01-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.1%/yr (Q2 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.3%/yr (FY01-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +18.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NEE (retrospective, 2011-10-14) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.42x (25.3% downside to Bear $41 / +60.4% upside to Bull $88) | Adj composite 3.36 vs market 2.02: gap +1.34 [UNDERVALUED] | +5% above the EPP floor $52 (11x FY11E $4.74) | Conservative 2-yr case: +34.7% total (+17.3%/yr) | At 11.6x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $73 sits at or below the BASE case; FPL energy sales +3.4% in Q2 2011, forward revenues +10.3% (no Q3 2011 revenue guide, Q2 2011 revenue as reported); no disruption theme is live for an electric utility on this date.
